notificationsHelp: Reminders are local and work offline. Choose a reminder on each entry; completed entries stop notifying. Overdue entries are repeated once a day for up to seven days.
backgroundHelp: Closing the window keeps the app in the tray or menu bar. Use Quit FriendlyAgenda there to exit completely. It must be running to notify; it does not start automatically with your computer.
notificationTestSent: Test notification sent. If it does not appear, check notification permissions and Focus / Do Not Disturb in system settings.
notificationsTestBody: Your local reminders are ready. You can now return to your agenda.
notificationsUnsupported: System notifications are unavailable on this device.
notificationSetupError: Couldn’t prepare notifications. Reopen the app and try again. On Windows, keep the executable in a permanent folder.
notificationsBlocked: The system could not display the notification. Check notification permissions in Windows or macOS settings.
notificationSaveError: Couldn’t save reminder history. Check the data folder; some reminders may repeat.
reminderDue: Scheduled for {date} · {time}. Open your agenda to review it.
reminderOverdue: Still pending · {date} · {time}. Open your agenda to review it.
calendarIntro: Bring your calendars into your agenda. Choose a locally exported file and review the entries before adding them.
calendarFormats: Google, Outlook, Apple, Yahoo and Proton: export an iCalendar (.ics) file. Google and Outlook CSV files are also supported. Unzip Google exports first. This is a one-time local import, without account access or online sync.
calendarRangeHelp: Only events in this range will be added. Recurrences and multi-day events become individual entries. Maximum range: five years; maximum 5,000 entries.
calendarSkipped: {count} invalid, cancelled or unsupported events were skipped. Review the preview before importing.
calendarMergeHelp: Your existing notes and entries are kept. Events already imported from the same file are skipped, preserving any edits you made in the agenda.
calendarRemindersHelp: Calendar alarms are not imported. If enabled here, reminders use each event’s time (or your all-day reminder time). Also enable system notifications in My space.
calendarInvalid: This file is not a valid calendar. Export it as ICS or a supported CSV and try again.
calendarLimit: This calendar is too large or complex. Use a smaller export or a shorter date range (20 MB / 5,000 entries maximum).
calendarRange: Choose a valid date range of up to five years.
